segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Thanks for the call. Attached is the order form for 62 seats, annual term starting 9/1, implementation included, net 30. Total is $52,080.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: We need 64 seats, not 62. Billing annual is fine. AP can issue a PO by Friday if the first invoice can be held until go-live on 10/7.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Updated to 64 seats. Invoice is generated at signature and due net 30, but we can align kickoff so your go-live stays 10/7. Revised total on the form is $53,760.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I can get this approved today if the PO is for the $48,640 you sent over chat. The PDF still shows $53,760.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, use $48,640 on the PO. The form may lag until I can get the revised copy back, but I’ll make sure the countersigned version matches before it goes to billing.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: PO attached for $48,640, 64 seats, start date 9/1. Please confirm this is enough to start scheduling onboarding.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Confirmed. I’ll get the order moving and have our onboarding manager send kickoff options for next week.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Thursday at 10:00 a.m. Eastern works. Please include finance@northlineparts.com on the invoice.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Done. Calendar invite sent for Thursday, and finance is added for invoicing.
